clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowfang Keep, Arugal commands the worgen he summoned against the Scourge. Madness and grief have made the former Dalaran wizard their self-proclaimed father, while his power threatens Silverpine Forest.

Before Lordaeron fell, Arugal belonged to the Kirin Tor. Some peers, including Dalar Dawnweaver, called him a charlatan who leaned on enchanted trinkets to make up for weak spellcraft. When the Scourge swept across the north during the Third War, Arugal searched for a weapon that could halt the undead. He used research by the late Dalaran mage Ur to pierce the veil between realms and summon the worgen. The ravenous beasts tore through the Scourge, but no one could contain their ferocity. Soon their hunger turned against innocent mortals.

The worgen slaughtered the Scourge, then turned on the wizards who summoned them. They besieged the ancestral seat of Baron Silverlaine, whose keep fell to their claws and fangs. Silverlaine and his retainers died in the massacre. Guilt shattered Arugal's mind, but he did not flee his creation. He adopted the beasts as his own offspring and renamed the fortress Shadowfang Keep. There he holds the ramparts, surrounded by ghostly victims and loyal hound-packs.
